scientific_hypothesis: A small fraction of difficult image-class states contributes most automatic-action gain, so a budgeted adaptive policy should recover most oracle gain with a low additional-action rate.

parent.failed_gate: 48/301 GT-positive fit pairs gained at least 0.05; 0.15946843853820597 is below 0.20

action_space.rule: reuse the parent V1 A0-through-A6 definitions, feasibility rules, source selection, action IDs, cache identities, and tie-break without modification
action_space.excluded_action_reason: S1-S4 added only 0.0026958580999459913 oracle mIoU over V1 and raised gain-at-least-0.05 coverage only from 48 to 49 fit pairs

validation40.prohibited_feedback: No threshold, prompt, action, feasibility rule, metric, or protocol field may change after any validation label is read.

metrics.scope: GT-positive validation image-class pairs only unless a metric explicitly states otherwise
metrics.canonical_present_macro_iou: arithmetic mean of A0 binary IoU over GT-positive image-class pairs; a canonical no-result is IoU zero
metrics.full_automatic_oracle: maximum IoU among feasible defined A0-A6 outputs; ties prefer lower measured incremental cost then A0-through-A6 order
metrics.positive_gain_concentration: sort strictly positive per-pair oracle gains descending; top count is ceil(positive_pair_count * fraction); divide captured positive gain by total positive gain

validation_gates.logic: all G1 through G8 must pass

G3_sparse_gain_concentration.top_count_rounding: ceil over strictly positive pair count

G8_cost.cache_scope: sum of exact immutable A1-A6 cache object sizes referenced by the validation40 generation report; reused canonical cache excluded

cost_accounting.per_action_seconds: action-required transforms and sessions, canonical replay for A6, prompt execution, coordinate restoration, and measured serialization
cost_accounting.generation_wall_seconds: single validation process wall time from entry through complete report serialization
cost_accounting.new_cache_bytes: exact referenced validation A1-A6 cache object bytes
cost_accounting.canonical_cache: reused and separately counted as references, not new bytes

atomic_regions.candidate_inputs: every existing nonempty individual candidate mask from A0-A6 for that state, in canonicalized content/identity order
atomic_regions.no_result_policy: record the action outcome and reason in state lineage but add no mask dimension
atomic_regions.zero_candidate_state_policy: emit the maximal four-connected all-zero-background atom over the full deployment-observable raster
atomic_regions.construction_valid_domain: full deployment-observable image raster; official VOC void is unknown during construction
atomic_regions.evaluation_void_policy: FINAL_EVALUATION overlays official labels, excludes label 255 from all evaluated coverage and usefulness metrics, and reports excluded void pixels
atomic_regions.signature: ordered binary membership over canonicalized candidate identities
required_invariants: every construction-valid pixel belongs to exactly one exact atom
atom area sums to construction-valid image area
evaluation void pixels do not enter evaluated valid coverage
every candidate is reconstructed with zero pixel error
candidate input order does not change the canonical result
repeat construction yields identical atom IDs
no out-of-bounds run, negative area, empty ID, or unassigned construction-valid pixel

stop_conditions: any protocol mutation after validation use
any label access during trajectory generation or atom construction
any cache corruption or incomplete accounting
any access to calibration, pilot-test, or official VOC val labels
any request to train QG, PAL, calibration, router, or student in this phase
